text:
maya_sen: Hey team — Catalyst (CATAL-42) onboarding. Noticing p95 latency spikes during peak windows (p50 ~120ms, p95 ~650ms) and token cost +22% vs baseline. Customer is sensitive to latency. Proactive idea: canary an INT8 quantized variant + route burst traffic to dedicated pool for the high-throughput windows. Want to coordinate CS <> Eng <> SRE for a low-risk roll. Any quick objections?

raj_patil: Saw same metrics on our traces. Spikes align with bursts >150 RPS and lots of long-context prompts so KV cache misses happen. INT8 q8 model should reduce per-token latency and GPU memory pressure. Also recommend enabling prefix/KV caching for frequently repeated prompts.

lin_zhou: +1. Suggest canary config below to start small:
```json
{
  "model": "llama-2-70b-q8",
  "routing_policy": "burst->dedicated-pool",
  "batching": {"max_tokens": 1024, "max_batch_ms": 5},
  "prefix_cache": true,
  "fallback_model": "mistral-7b-v0"
}
```
Keep A/B and a rollback policy. Also watch tokenization differences with quantized weights.

tom_keller: I'll set up an enablement sync with Catalyst engs tomorrow 11:30 PT to walk through expected behavior + test plan. Also will request top-10 prompt set from them for eval.

maya_sen: Thanks. Need these before canary start: (1) customer prompt set, (2) success criteria (latency targets + quality budget), (3) contact for immediate rollback. Can we also surface per-route cost delta and automated quality regression checks in Console?

raj_patil: Yes — I will wire Console eval hooks. Plan: 5% traffic A/B for 24h, snapshot metrics (latency P50/P95, tokens/sec, cost/token), then 25% if green. I'll add automated alerts for quality regressions (ROUGE/EM surrogate + hallucination heuristics).

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated by raj_patil at 2780012380. canary-id: canary-2780012380. Status: provisioning nodes -> attaching perf monitor.

lin_zhou: Small caution — INT8 reduces mem and latency but can induce subtle tokenization/regression issues on long coherence tasks. Include adversarial prompts in eval (multi-turn, entity preservation).

maya_sen: Good call. I'll compile a 15-sample adversarial list from Catalyst and add to the eval bundle. Also will prepare a short customer-facing note describing expected improvements and rollback plan.

tom_keller: Invite sent to catalyst@customer.com for tomorrow 11:30 PT. Added agenda: metrics baseline, canary plan, rollback, success criteria.

raj_patil: Canary logs + perf snapshots will be posted to Confluence and I'll paste summary here once we have 1h of stable traffic. Link: https://redwood.internal/catalyst-canary (internal).

maya_sen: Great. Next steps checklist in thread: 1) tom confirm invite (done), 2) catalyst prompt set by customer, 3) raj starts 5% A/B canary, 4) lin runs eval suite, 5) maya prepares customer note + tracks renewal risk signal. Leaving this thread as the single CS <> Eng handoff. :rocket: :thumbsup:

raj_patil: Acknowledged — will post first perf snapshot by 2780012405.

maya_sen: Thanks all — I'll ping if Catalyst reports any regressions.
